# EggRate India

Source: https://www.e2necc.com/home/eggprice
Last official sheet in package: 2026-08-25
Markets: 34

Historical archive: January 2026 through August 2026, with bootstrap history and an automated backfill job.

Disclaimer: E2NECC says its suggested prices are merely suggestive, not mandatory, and are published for reference and information of the trade and industry.
